ash: Quick note: runtime has slightly different cold-start perf for the quant fallback — add a one-liner about 1.2x latency increase for cold starts with quant variants.
oliver: I'll update the JS SDK snippet to show variant selection + fallback example. Patch coming in review comments.
maya: Pushed a suggested snippet in the PR comments. Current snippet (JS SDK v4):
```js
// prefer the fp32 variant, fallback to quant if not available
const res = await client.generate({
  model: "halcyon5b",
  variant: "halcyon5b-fp32",
  fallback_variants: ["halcyon5b-quant"],
  input: "Summarize the doc",
  max_tokens: 512
});
console.log(res.output[0].content);
```
ken: Could we also add the small YAML marker in the model catalog so the console can surface the fallback? Something like `variants.fallback_allowed: true` in the model card metadata.
maya: Yup — added that change to the YAML in the PR. Snippet: `variants:
  - name: halcyon5b-fp32
  - name: halcyon5b-quant
    fallback: true`
